mapper.select: select i.id, i.introspect_id as introspectId, t.title as introspectTitle, i.occur_date as occurDate, i.content, i.sort_order as sortOrder, i.user_id as userId from mes_rec_introspect_item i left join mes_rec_introspect t on t.id = i.introspect_id and t.deleted_flag = 0 where i.deleted_flag = 0 and i.user_id = #{userId} and date(i.occur_date) = date(#{occurDate}) order by i.sort_order asc, i.id asc
